payload.name: Cypris Q
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cypris Q brings specialized R&D and innovation intelligence to your team in ChatGPT through a secure connection to your Cypris account.

Unlock access to Cypris's global intelligence layer across patents, scientific literature, chemical compounds, companies, and technical markets. Your team can use Cypris Q inside ChatGPT to investigate prior art, freedom to operate, competitive landscapes, technology trends, whitespace opportunities, and other critical questions across the R&D and IP stage-gate process.

Ask a research question and Cypris goes to work, returning a cited report in the conversation a few minutes later.

Cypris is purpose-built for high-stakes technical and strategic research. Responses are grounded in authoritative source material, with citations that allow users to review the evidence behind each finding.

Cypris Q is designed for R&D, IP, innovation, strategy, and technical teams that want to make ChatGPT more valuable by extending it with specialized datasets, research workflows, and domain-specific intelligence.
payload.longDescription:
通过与Cypris账户的安全连接，Cypris Q将专业的研发和创新情报带入您的团队，在ChatGPT中实现高效协作。

解锁Cypris全球情报层，覆盖专利、科学文献、化学物质、企业及技术市场领域。
您的团队可在ChatGPT内使用Cypris Q开展专利检索、自由实施分析、竞争格局研究、技术趋势洞察、市场空白机会挖掘等关键课题，贯穿研发与知识产权阶段门禁流程。

提出研究问题后，Cypris将开始工作，几分钟内返回带有引用的报告。

Cypris专为高风险的技术与战略研究场景设计。
所有回复均基于权威资料，通过引用体系让用户可追溯每个结论的证据来源。

Cypris Q专为研发、知识产权、创新、战略和技术团队设计，旨在通过扩展专用数据集、研究工作流程和领域特定智能，提升ChatGPT的实用价值。

payload.name: SciDraft
payload.description: 从研究资料中逐段生成科学论文草稿
payload.summaryOriginal: 研究資料から科学論文ドラフトを段落ごとに作成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
自然科学・医学の研究テーマ、研究計画書、進捗資料をもとに、科学論文の構成とドラフトを対話形式で作成する会員向けの執筆支援です。研究が計画段階か実施済みかを区別し、未取得の結果や不足情報を埋めずに確認します。Introductionから各セクションへ進み、原稿は段落ごとに利用者の確認を待ちながら作成・推敲します。

プラグインを選択して研究資料を添付するだけでも開始できます。作成言語が未指定の場合だけ日本語・英語を確認し、指定済みの言語を尊重します。既存原稿の改稿や、研究計画から論文化に必要な情報を整理する場面にも対応します。生成された文章、引用文献、数値、研究上の主張は利用者による確認が必要です。診断や治療を行うサービスではありません。

執筆支援の利用には、SciDraftの有効な利用権を持つ会員アカウントへの接続が必要です。ChatGPT／Codexでプラグインを追加した後、利用登録時と同じログイン方法・同じ会員アカウントで接続してください。会員アカウントはChatGPTの登録アカウントと異なっていても利用できます。ログインだけでは利用権は付与されず、SciGrantの利用権とは別です。

会員サーバーは認証、製品別の利用権確認、保存済み執筆手順の配信を行い、その手順を受けたChatGPT／Codexが執筆を支援します。研究資料・原稿・会話本文をMCPツールの入力として受け取りません。資料はChatGPT／Codexの会話に添付してください。論文の実投稿や決済は行いません。

有効な利用権を確認できない場合は、執筆手順を取得できません。既に取得した内容や過去のチャットを削除する機能はありません。
payload.longDescription:
面向会员的写作辅助服务，通过对话形式根据自然科学/医学研究主题、研究计划书及进展资料创建论文结构与草稿。系统会区分研究处于计划阶段还是实施阶段，并在未获取结果或存在信息缺失时进行确认。从引言部分逐步推进至各章节，稿件将按段落形式在等待用户确认后逐步完成和润色

仅需选择插件并上传研究资料即可开始。若未指定语言则会确认使用日语或英语，已指定语言将被尊重。支持现有稿件修改及从研究计划整理论文所需信息的场景。生成的文本、参考文献、数据和研究主张均需用户确认，本服务不提供医疗或治疗建议

使用写作辅助功能需连接拥有有效使用权限的SciDraft会员账户。在ChatGPT/Codex中添加插件后，请使用与注册时相同的登录方式和会员账户进行连接。会员账户可与ChatGPT注册账户不同，但仅登录行为不会授予使用权限，且该权限与SciGrant权限相互独立

会员服务器负责认证、产品专属使用权限验证及已保存写作流程的分发，接收到流程的ChatGPT/Codex将提供写作支持。不会接收研究资料/稿件/对话文本作为MCP工具的输入，资料需作为附件上传至ChatGPT/Codex对话中。本服务不处理论文实际投稿或支付相关操作

无法确认有效使用权限时，将无法获取写作流程。已获取的内容或历史聊天记录不具备删除功能

payload.name: Arca FDA, Trials & PubMed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Arca Life Sciences searches a curated index of public regulatory, clinical, and scientific records and returns results with links to the original source.

What you can search:
- FDA drug records: labels, Drugs@FDA approvals and review documents, complete response letters, warning letters, Form 483s, inspections, import refusals, Orange Book, Purple Book, NDC, drug shortages, and postmarket requirements
- FDA device records: 510(k), PMA, registrations, GUDID, and MAUDE adverse event reports
- ClinicalTrials.gov studies
- PubMed and Europe PMC literature, ranked with citation counts and open-access status
- VAERS, CDC public-health data, EU expert panels, and BfArM/PMDA device vigilance

Who it is for: regulatory affairs, quality, pharmacovigilance, clinical, and medical-affairs teams, and anyone researching drugs, devices, or the evidence behind them.

Limitations: it only searches public records that Arca mirrors, so it has no access to your own documents, patient data, or non-public FDA correspondence. It is read-only and cannot file reports or submissions. Results are research material, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Arca Life Sciences 搜索经过筛选的公共监管、临床和科学记录索引，并返回包含原始来源链接的搜索结果。

可搜索内容包括：
- FDA药物记录：说明书、Drugs@FDA审批和审评文件、完整回复信、警告信、Form 483表格、检查记录、进口拒绝记录、《橙色书》、《紫色书》、NDC编码、药品短缺信息及上市后要求
- FDA设备记录：510(k)申请、PMA申请、注册信息、GUDID数据库和MAUDE不良事件报告
- ClinicalTrials.gov临床研究
- PubMed和欧洲PMC文献（按引用次数和开放获取状态排序）
- VAERS数据库、CDC公共卫生数据、欧盟专家小组信息以及BfArM/PMDA设备警戒信息

适用对象：法规事务、质量控制、药物警戒、临床研究和医学事务团队，以及所有从事药物、设备研究或相关证据分析的专业人士。

使用限制：仅可搜索Arca镜像的公共记录，无法访问您的自有文件、患者数据或非公开的FDA通信记录。
该工具为只读模式，无法提交报告或申请。
搜索结果仅限研究资料，不构成医疗建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search FDA drug and device records, Search ClinicalTrials.gov studies, Search PubMed literature, Read the full text of a source record

payload.name: Helical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Helical lets you run biological foundation models on your own single-cell data, from the chat you're already in.

Upload an .h5ad dataset into your private Helical project, pick a model — scGPT, Geneformer, TranscriptFormer, Cell2Sentence or Nicheformer — and compute embeddings on Helical's GPUs. Follow the run while it goes, read the error if it fails, and download the embeddings when it finishes.

Nothing starts on its own. A run is quoted and queued first, and only begins once you approve it in a second, separate step. Every tool works inside the one project your account owns.

Runs use the credits in your existing Helical account.
payload.longDescription:
Helical让您直接在当前聊天界面中，使用自己的单细胞数据运行生物基础模型。

将.h5ad数据集上传至私有Helical项目，选择scGPT、Geneformer、TranscriptFormer、Cell2Sentence或Nicheformer模型，在Helical的GPU上计算嵌入。在运行过程中实时跟踪进度，如遇失败可查看错误信息，运行完成后下载嵌入结果。

任何运行都不会自动启动。首先会生成报价并进入队列，需在第二个独立步骤中确认批准后才会开始执行。所有工具均在您账户所属的单一项目内运行。

运行过程会消耗您现有Helical账户中的信用点。

payload.name: Ansvar Gateway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ansvar Systems AB is a Swedish cybersecurity company that gives AI agents verifiable access to law, regulation and security standards.

Customers connect the AI assistant they already use (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or any MCP-compatible client) to the Ansvar Gateway and run compliance work directly in that assistant: regulatory gap analyses, threat models (STRIDE/LINDDUN, TARA), DPIAs and audit preparation, grounded in more than 300 curated corpora of EU and international legislation, case law, preparatory works, regulator guidance and security standards.

Every answer carries paragraph-level citations to the official source. When a source is unavailable, the platform returns an error instead of guessing, accuracy over availability is an architectural rule, not a disclaimer. All content is ingested from the original publisher under verified licensing, so results can be relied on and redistributed.

Ansvar serves legal insurers, compliance teams, security consultancies and software teams that need to know which rules apply;  NIS2, GDPR, DORA, CRA, the EU AI Act, national and sector regulation — and to prove where every answer came from.
payload.longDescription:
Ansvar Systems AB 是一家瑞典网络安全公司，为 AI 智能体提供可验证的法律、法规和安全标准访问能力。

客户将已经使用的 AI 助手（Claude、Microsoft Copilot、ChatGPT 或任何兼容 MCP 的客户端）连接到 Ansvar Gateway，即可直接在该助手中开展合规工作：法规差距分析、威胁建模（STRIDE/LINDDUN、TARA）、DPIA 和审计准备，依据是超过 300 个精选资料库，涵盖欧盟及国际立法、判例法、立法准备文件、监管机构指引和安全标准。

每个答案都提供指向官方来源的段落级引用。来源不可用时，平台会返回错误而不是猜测；准确性优先于可用性是架构规则，而非免责声明。所有内容都在核实许可的前提下从原始发布者获取，因此结果可信赖，也可以再分发。

Ansvar 服务于法律保险机构、合规团队、安全咨询公司和软件团队，帮助它们了解哪些规则适用，包括 NIS2、GDPR、DORA、CRA、欧盟 AI 法案、国家和行业监管规定，并证明每个答案的来源。

payload.name: Orca Security

For teams that want the reasoning without writing the prompts, Orca maintains the AI Skills Hub, an open-source GitHub repo of agent skills. The result: security and engineering teams work across cloud, code, and AI from a single workspace, with Orca's reasoning behind every answer.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: RelayShield Scam Checks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RelayShield Free Scam Checks screens links, crypto wallets, suspicious emails, and email addresses against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus — 115 monitored Telegram marketplaces, 494K+ indicators, 7.8M+ citations — before you click, pay, or reply. Four read-only tools: check a URL for phishing and malware, screen a crypto wallet for sanctions and scam flags, score a suspicious email for phishing signals, and look up whether an email appears in known data breaches. Free, no signup, no API key. Verdicts are FLAGGED or unknown — the tools never report anything as safe, because absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
payload.longDescription: RelayShield Free Scam Checks 会将链接、加密钱包、可疑邮件和邮箱地址与 RelayShield 威胁情报库比对，该库包含 115 个受监控 Telegram 市场、494K+ 指标和 7.8M+ 引用。四个工具全部只读：检查 URL 的钓鱼和恶意软件、筛查钱包的制裁与诈骗标记、评估可疑邮件的钓鱼信号、查询邮箱是否出现在已知数据泄露中。免费、无需注册或 API 密钥。结果只会是 FLAGGED（已标记）或 unknown（未知），不会报告“安全”，因为没有证据不等于不存在风险。

payload.name: Palisade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Palisade helps email teams investigate SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MTA-STS issues. Review monitored domains, DMARC pass rates and sending sources, inspect DNS and SPF records, and retrieve remediation tasks with supporting evidence. Use the results to prioritize fixes and prepare DNS change plans. This plugin provides read-only access to your Palisade account: it does not publish DNS records, modify domains, send email, or manage billing. A Palisade account is required.
payload.longDescription: Palisade 帮助邮件团队调查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和 MTA-STS 问题。查看受监控域名、DMARC 通过率和发送来源，检查 DNS 与 SPF 记录，并获取带证据的修复任务。利用结果确定修复优先级并准备 DNS 变更计划。此插件只读访问 Palisade 账户：不会发布 DNS 记录、修改域名、发送邮件或管理计费。需要 Palisade 账户。

payload.name: Guardio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guardio helps you check suspicious links and understand your online protection from ChatGPT and Codex. Check a website before opening it, or check links extracted from a suspicious message without sending the message body to Guardio.

Connect your Guardio account to review protection setup, scan activity, recent data leaks, linked-service counts, and security recommendations. You can also check whether an email address or phone number appears in known data breaches. Results describe known exposure; they do not reveal leaked passwords.

When you ask, Guardio can guide setup of its protection in a supported browser and receive your feedback about these tools. Setup depends on browser support and available permissions. Account features depend on your access and plan.

Guardio records each link check on your account, and a dangerous result appears in your account activity. A link result reports known threats at the time of the check. It is not a guarantee that a site or an entire message is safe. The plugin does not scan local executable files or provide continuous browser protection merely by being connected.
payload.longDescription:
Guardio可帮助您检查可疑链接，并了解ChatGPT和Codex中的在线保护情况。在打开网站前检查链接，或检查从可疑消息中提取的链接，而无需将消息正文发送至Guardio。

将您的Guardio账户连接以查看保护设置、扫描活动、近期数据泄露、关联服务数量和安全建议。您还可以检查电子邮箱地址或电话号码是否出现在已知数据泄露中。结果描述已知的暴露情况；它们不会揭示泄露的密码。

当您提出请求时，Guardio可以指导在支持的浏览器中设置其保护功能，并接收您对这些工具的反馈。设置取决于浏览器支持和可用权限。账户功能取决于您的访问权限和计划类型。

Guardio会在您的账户中记录每次链接检查，危险结果会在账户活动中标注。链接结果会报告检查时的已知威胁。这不代表该网站或整条消息都是安全的。该插件不会扫描本地可执行文件，仅通过连接无法提供持续的浏览器保护。

payload.name: AttackerView
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask whether a website is set up securely and get an answer in seconds. AttackerView checks a domain's security headers and Content Security Policy, clickjacking protection, the HTTP to HTTPS redirect, TLS configuration, DNS, DNSSEC and CAA records, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS). Each problem comes with its severity, the evidence observed and how to fix it.

For developers, founders and IT teams who want a quick read on a site's configuration, their own or one they depend on.

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Is This AI Agent Safe?

There are more than 800 of them, covering coding assistants, automation tools and hundreds of MCP servers.

It also checks statements about AI agents against a ledger of 564 claims, each sorted by what it rests on (a published result, the book's argument, a method you can run, or the author's own account) and each with a citation. Where a claim rests on an outside source, the result says what that source does and does not establish.

Ask it how or why about working with AI agents and it answers from Greenlit's books: it finds the passage in the free first chapters, the concept pages, the glossary and the claim ledger that bears on your question, quotes it with a link to the exact section, and points you to the page where the rest of the topic is. And when you want to go deeper, it finds the right practical book on working with AI, with a free first chapter to read.

Read-only. No account and no sign-in. Nothing you ask is stored beyond short-lived request logs.
payload.longDescription:
询问AI代理、MCP服务器、编码助手或AI产品是否安全可用，Greenlit Books将提供直接评估结果，包含提升安全性的设置步骤以及完整评测链接。每个评估均基于产品自身代码、文档和设置进行阅读分析，并注明所读版本及时间。目前已有超过800份评估，涵盖编码助手、自动化工具和数百个MCP服务器。

payload.name: BlindOracle Agent Trust
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BlindOracle Agent Trust answers one question before you work with or hire an AI agent: what is its record?

What it does
- Trust badge: a one-line badge for an agent name or wallet, built from BlindOracle's audit registry and settlement history. An agent BlindOracle has never seen comes back as UNVERIFIED with empty fields; the plugin never invents a score.
- Reputation lookup: completed and failed jobs, disputes and the trust-score trend for the same subject.
- Service list: which BlindOracle services exist and which ones can be used from ChatGPT.

How it works
All tools are read-only. Lookups share a daily limit across all ChatGPT users; when it is reached the tool says so and you can try again the next day. Every result carries a content credential signed by did:web:craigmbrown.com, and the result card shows that the signature is attached. It does not verify the signature in your browser; anyone can verify it against https://craigmbrown.com/.well-known/did.json.

What it does not do
The plugin never asks for wallet keys, seed phrases or payment details and never moves funds. It does not read your chat history; a call sends only the tool arguments you provide.

Who it is for
People and teams choosing agents to delegate work to, marketplace operators vetting counterparties, and developers building agent-to-agent workflows who want an independent record before the first transaction.

Limits
BlindOracle's record covers agents that have transacted with or been audited through BlindOracle. A missing record means "no record here", not "unsafe". Badges expire and are reissued; the expiry date is shown with each badge.
payload.longDescription:
BlindOracle Agent Trust在您合作或雇佣AI代理前，回答一个关键问题：它的记录如何？

功能说明
- 信任徽章：通过BlindOracle的审计注册表和结算记录生成的单行徽章，用于代理名称或钱包地址。
对于BlindOracle从未见过的代理，会显示为“未验证”且字段为空；插件不会自行编造评分。
- 信誉查询：显示同一主体的已完成和失败任务、争议记录以及信任评分趋势。
- 服务列表：展示BlindOracle现有的服务，以及可在ChatGPT中使用的服务项。

工作原理
所有工具均为只读模式。
所有查询共享ChatGPT用户的每日限额；达到上限后工具会提示，并可在次日重试。
每个结果均带有由did:web:craigmbrown.com签名的内容凭证，结果卡片会显示签名已附加。
该工具不会在浏览器中验证签名；任何人都可访问https://craigmbrown.com/.well-known/did.json进行验证。

不支持的功能
插件不会请求钱包密钥、种子短语或支付信息，也不会操作资金。
不会读取您的聊天记录；调用仅发送您提供的工具参数。

适用对象
适用于需要委派工作的个人和团队、需审核交易对手的市场运营方，以及希望在首次交易前获取独立记录的开发者。

数据范围
BlindOracle的记录覆盖与BlindOracle有过交易或接受过审计的代理。
记录缺失仅表示“此处无记录”，不代表“不安全”。
徽章会过期并重新签发；每次徽章均显示有效期限。

payload.name: ScamCheck

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: ScanMalware
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ScanMalware helps security teams investigate suspicious and phishing URLs. It renders a URL in a sandboxed browser, records what the page loaded and did, and keeps public scans in a searchable archive, so one reported phishing page can lead to the rest of its campaign.

With this plugin you can:
- Look up what the archive already knows about a domain, URL or IP address: the scanner's verdict and risk factors, network requests, indicators, TLS and JARM details, detected technologies, YARA matches, OCR text and RDAP data.
- Find related scans by domain, IP, ASN, JARM signature, favicon hash, screenshot hash, fuzzy hash, OCR text, tracking key or JavaScript fingerprint.
- Look up Certificate Transparency records for a domain or IP.
- Submit a new URL for scanning, choosing whether the result is public or unlisted, and read the verdict when the scan completes.

The included skill walks through pivoting from one phishing URL to its sibling hosts, and avoids two common mistakes: giving a domain a verdict that belongs to a page that only redirected to it, or to another tenant on a shared hosting platform; and blocking on shared IP addresses or TLS fingerprints that describe a hosting platform rather than an attacker.

ScanMalware is a defensive tool. Pages are opened in ScanMalware's isolated browser, not on your device. No account or API key is needed. 126 of the 128 tools only read data; the two that write submit a URL for scanning and record a safe or malicious vote on a scan. A public scan publishes the URL and its results, so use "unlisted" for confidential targets.

ScanMalware is operated by Triop AB in Sweden.
payload.longDescription:
ScanMalware帮助安全团队调查可疑及钓鱼网址。它会在沙盒浏览器中渲染网址，记录页面加载内容及操作行为，并将公开扫描结果存入可搜索的档案库，因此一个被举报的钓鱼页面可关联到整个攻击链。

- 查询档案库中已知的域名/网址/IP地址信息：扫描器的判定结果与风险因素、网络请求记录、指标数据、TLS和JARM详情、检测到的技术、YARA匹配项、OCR文字内容及RDAP数据。
- 通过域名、IP、ASN、JARM签名、favicon哈希、截图哈希、模糊哈希、OCR文字、追踪密钥或JavaScript指纹查找关联扫描记录。

内置的关联技能可引导您从一个钓鱼网址追踪到其子域名主机，同时避免两个常见错误：将仅通过重定向指向该域名的页面判定为该域名的威胁等级；或因共享主机平台的其他租户而误封共享IP地址或TLS指纹。

payload.longDescription: 通过在ChatGPT中直接创建产品、价格和支付链接，加速支付集成开发。从ChatGPT管理支付、订阅、发票、退款、争议和客户信息，全面掌控业务运营。无需离开ChatGPT即可搜索Stripe文档并获取集成建议，让支付系统构建与调试效率全面提升。

payload.name: Xero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check your P&L, cash position, outstanding invoices, top customers and more — directly from ChatGPT. Xero surfaces real-time financial summaries with flexible date ranges, year-over-year comparisons, and links back to Xero for deeper analysis. ChatGPT connects with read-only access. Any data retrieved is used only to respond to your questions and is never stored between sessions.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查看损益、现金头寸、未结发票、主要客户等。Xero 提供实时财务摘要，支持灵活的日期范围、同比比较，以及返回 Xero 进行深入分析的链接。ChatGPT 以只读权限连接。检索的任何数据仅用于回答你的问题，绝不会在会话之间存储。

payload.name: Era Context
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your complete financial picture, ready for real conversations

Connect every bank account, credit card, and investment account to ChatGPT — then ask it anything about your money. Era Context unifies your accounts, categorizes transactions, surfaces recurring charges, and tracks cash flow so ChatGPT can give you answers that are actually grounded in your data.

What you can do:
- See where your money went — Compare spending across months, categories, or accounts. Ask why a month felt expensive, and get a real answer.
- Catch problems before month-end — Project where you'll land on dining, travel, or any category before the damage is done.
- Audit your subscriptions — Surface every recurring charge across all your cards, flag what you're not using, and calculate what canceling the bottom five would save you.
- Get a grounded answer to "can I afford this" — Tell any AI agent what you're considering. It'll check your cash flow, upcoming bills, and buffer — and give you a straight answer.
payload.longDescription:
完整的财务全貌，支持真正有依据的对话

将所有银行账户、信用卡和投资账户连接到 ChatGPT，然后询问任何与你的资金有关的问题。Era Context 汇总账户、分类交易、发现定期扣款并跟踪现金流，让 ChatGPT 能够根据你的真实数据给出答案。

你可以：
- 看钱花在了哪里——比较不同月份、类别或账户的支出。询问为什么某个月花费特别高，并得到有依据的答案。
- 月底前发现问题——在支出失控之前，预测餐饮、旅行或任何类别最终会花费多少。
- 审核订阅——找出所有卡上的每笔定期扣款，标记你未使用的项目，并计算取消使用价值最低的五项能节省多少。
- 对“我负担得起吗”获得有依据的答案——告诉任意 AI 智能体你正在考虑什么。它会检查现金流、即将到期的账单和资金缓冲，并给出直接的回答。

payload.name: Massive
payload.description: 实时股票数据及更多市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Massive brings institutional-grade market data directly into ChatGPT. Query real-time and historical stocks data, options data, futures data, indices data, forex data, and crypto data through Massive.com's financial data API — no code or scraping required.

Stocks & equities: Real-time stock prices, historical stock data, tick-level trades and quotes, OHLC aggregates and candlestick bars, market snapshots, and stock ticker reference data for all US equities and ETFs, sourced from all US exchanges.

Options: Options contracts data including options chains, options prices, quotes, trades, open interest, and historical options data across the full US listed options market.

Futures: Futures market data including futures contracts, futures prices, trades, quotes, and historical futures data across major products.

Indices: Real-time and historical index data including index values and aggregates for major market indices.

Forex & crypto: Currency pairs, exchange rates, crypto prices, and historical FX and cryptocurrency market data.

Beyond prices, pull company fundamentals and financials, corporate actions like dividends and stock splits, market news, technical indicators (SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI), and market status. Ask ChatGPT natural-language questions — "show me NVDA's opening cross" or "chart AAPL's daily bars this quarter" — and get answers backed by licensed, exchange-sourced market data.

Built for traders, quants, analysts, and developers who need accurate stock market data, equities data, and multi-asset market data inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Massive 将机构级市场数据直接带入 ChatGPT。通过 Massive.com 的金融数据 API 查询实时和历史股票、期权、期货、指数、外汇及加密资产数据，无需编写代码或抓取网页。

股票与权益类证券：覆盖全部美国股票和 ETF，提供来自美国所有交易所的实时股价、历史股票数据、逐笔交易与报价、OHLC 汇总和蜡烛图数据、市场快照及股票代码参考数据。

期权：覆盖完整的美国上市期权市场，提供期权合约数据，包括期权链、期权价格、报价、成交、未平仓量及历史期权数据。

期货：提供主要品种的期货市场数据，包括期货合约、价格、成交、报价和历史期货数据。

指数：提供主要市场指数的实时和历史数据，包括指数值及汇总数据。

外汇与加密资产：提供货币对、汇率、加密资产价格，以及历史外汇和加密货币市场数据。

除价格外，还可获取公司基本面和财务数据、股息及股票拆分等公司行动、市场新闻、技术指标（SMA、EMA、MACD、RSI）和市场状态。用自然语言向 ChatGPT 提问，例如“显示 NVDA 的开盘集合竞价”或“绘制 AAPL 本季度的日线图”，即可得到基于获授权的交易所市场数据的答案。

专为需要在 ChatGPT 内获取准确股票市场数据、权益类证券数据和多资产市场数据的交易者、量化人员、分析师及开发者打造。

payload.name: QBO Connector by Meridian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This connector lets ChatGPT and Codex securely read from and write to QuickBooks Online.

Some things you can do:
• Connect multiple QuickBooks Online companies to the same agent (great for booking intercompany JEs)
• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company
• Create arbitrary QuickBooks transactions, including journal entries
• Bulk-create invoices or import credit card transactions
• Upload and attach receipts and supporting files to QuickBooks transactions
• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template
• The craziest use case I tried was "Clone the contents of QBO A into QBO B", and… it worked
payload.longDescription:
此连接器让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 安全地读取和写入 QuickBooks Online。

你可以做的一些事情：
• 将多家 QuickBooks Online 公司连接到同一智能体（非常适合录入公司间会计分录）
• 为每家公司分别选择只读或读写访问权限
• 创建任意 QuickBooks 交易，包括会计分录
• 批量创建发票或导入信用卡交易
• 上传收据和支持文件，并将其附加到 QuickBooks 交易
• 自动填充你公司专用的报告模板
• 我试过最疯狂的用例是“把 QBO A 的内容克隆到 QBO B”，而且……成功了

payload.name: Longbridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research US and HK stocks with market data, fundamentals, analyst ratings, news, filings, screeners, movers, rankings, and short interest. Connect your Longbridge account to analyze balances, positions, profit and loss, cash flow, statements, watchlists, and order history.
payload.longDescription: 利用市场数据、基本面、分析师评级、新闻、披露文件、筛选器、涨跌异动、排行榜和卖空持仓研究美国及香港股票。连接 Longbridge 账户，分析余额、持仓、损益、现金流、对账单、自选列表及订单历史。

payload.name: Alpha Vantage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real-time and historical stock prices, quotes, and price history for any ticker, spanning stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, options, forex, commodities, and global indices. Licensed by major global exchanges for institutional-grade accuracy.

Access 200+ global market indices, ETF profiles and sector allocations, and top gainers/losers/most active tickers. Pull company fundamentals, financial statements, P/E ratio, EPS, market cap, and dividend yield.

Ingest earnings call transcripts, track earnings and IPO calendars, monitor insider transactions and institutional holdings, and review stock splits and dividends. Score news sentiment by ticker, and analyze options chains, put-call ratios, and volume/open-interest ratios for market positioning and sentiment analysis.

Query 50+ technical indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, and more), plus advanced rolling and fixed-window analytics for volatility, correlation, and performance metrics, ideal for backtesting and building trading strategies.

Check forex and currency exchange rates, global commodity prices (gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agricultural goods), and economic indicators like GDP, CPI, inflation, unemployment, treasury yields, and the federal funds rate.

Built for portfolio analysis, valuation modeling, quantitative research, and agentic workflows, from quick ticker lookups to multi-step financial analysis.
payload.longDescription:
获取任何证券代码的实时和历史股价、行情及价格历史，涵盖股票、ETF、共同基金、期权、外汇、大宗商品和全球指数。获得全球主要交易所许可，提供机构级准确性。

访问 200+ 个全球市场指数、ETF 概况及行业配置，以及涨幅最大、跌幅最大和交易最活跃的证券代码。获取公司基本面、财务报表、市盈率（P/E）、每股收益（EPS）、市值和股息率。

获取财报电话会议文字稿，跟踪财报和 IPO 日历，监控内部人士交易与机构持仓，并查看股票拆分及股息。按证券代码为新闻情绪评分，分析期权链、认沽认购比率及成交量/未平仓量比率，用于市场持仓状况和情绪分析。

查询 50+ 个技术指标（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、布林带、VWAP 等），以及针对波动率、相关性和表现指标的高级滚动窗口与固定窗口分析，适用于回测和构建交易策略。

查看外汇和货币汇率、全球大宗商品价格（金、银、石油、天然气、农产品），以及 GDP、CPI、通胀、失业率、美国国债收益率和联邦基金利率等经济指标。

为投资组合分析、估值建模、量化研究和智能体工作流程而构建，支持从快速证券代码查询到多步骤金融分析的各种场景。

payload.name: Bigdata.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bigdata.com is the AI grounding layer for finance, bringing cited financial research directly into ChatGPT. Research stocks and companies, follow the latest news on your portfolio, and query market data, fundamentals, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, broker and analyst research, sentiment signals, and premium news, with every answer grounded in real, citable sources instead of guesses.

Search billions of documents spanning 25+ years, including 10M+ new public news documents monthly, 200+ premium news sources such as Financial Times, Benzinga, MT Newswires, CNBC and more, filings across 50+ countries, 30+ years of fundamentals, expert interviews, and podcasts. RavenPack's financial knowledge graph resolves company and entity names automatically, so one plain-language question surfaces the right filings, transcripts, news, and data. No manual ticker matching, fabricated numbers, or invented quotes.

Beyond public content, upload and search your own private documents, including notes, internal research, artifacts, and files, alongside public filings and market data, so proprietary research and public sources can be used together in the same query.

Built for anyone making a financial decision, from individual investors researching a stock or tracking their portfolio to analysts at hedge funds, asset managers, and investment banks. Run an initiation report, compare two 10-Ks, prep a pre-earnings or pre-FOMC briefing, track a competitor, catch a sentiment shift before consensus does, or build a sourced brief before a call, all from one grounded search.

Connect in seconds. No setup, no code. You're searching cited financial data from your first prompt.
payload.longDescription:
Bigdata.com 是金融领域的 AI 事实依据层，将带引用的金融研究直接带入 ChatGPT。研究股票与公司、关注投资组合的最新新闻，查询市场数据、基本面、SEC 申报文件、财报电话会议文字稿、券商与分析师研究、情绪信号和优质新闻。每个答案都基于真实、可引用的来源，而非猜测。

搜索跨度达 25+ 年的数十亿份文档，包括每月新增的 超过 1,000 万（10M+）份公开新闻文档，Financial Times、Benzinga、MT Newswires、CNBC 等 200+ 个优质新闻来源，50+ 个国家的申报文件，30+ 年的基本面数据，以及专家访谈与播客。RavenPack 的金融知识图谱会自动识别公司和实体名称，一句日常语言的问题即可找到相关申报文件、文字稿、新闻和数据。无需手工匹配股票代码，不编造数字或引文。

除了公开内容，还能上传和搜索自己的私有文档，包括笔记、内部研究、工作成果与文件，并将其与公开申报文件和市场数据一同检索，在同一次查询中结合专有研究与公开来源。

面向所有需要做财务决策的人，从研究股票或追踪投资组合的个人投资者，到对冲基金、资产管理公司和投资银行的分析师。通过一次有来源依据的搜索，完成首次覆盖报告、比较两份 10-K、准备财报前或 FOMC 前简报、追踪竞争对手、在市场共识形成前发现情绪变化，或在电话会议前撰写附有来源的简报。

数秒即可连接，无需配置或编程。从第一条提示开始，就能搜索带引用的金融数据。

payload.name: Binance
payload.description: 探索 Binance 市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Binance for ChatGPT lets you access and explore Binance public, read-only market data using natural language. Retrieve current and historical prices, order books, recent trades, candlesticks (klines), and exchange metadata across Spot, Futures, and Options. No authentication is required. This app does not access user accounts and does not support trading or transactions.

Market data is provided “as is” from Binance’s public APIs and may be delayed, incomplete, or subject to change. This information is for informational purposes only and should not be relied upon for trading or financial decisions. Binance makes no representations or warranties regarding accuracy or timeliness and disclaims all liability arising from use of this data.
payload.longDescription:
Binance for ChatGPT 让您使用自然语言访问和探索 Binance 公开、只读的市场数据。获取现货、期货和期权的当前及历史价格、订单簿、近期成交、蜡烛图（K 线）及交易所元数据。无需身份验证。此应用不会访问用户账户，也不支持交易或转账等交易操作。

市场数据来自 Binance 公开 API，按“现状”提供，可能存在延迟、不完整或发生变化。这些信息仅供参考，不应作为交易或财务决策的依据。Binance 不对准确性或及时性作出任何声明或保证，并免除因使用这些数据而产生的一切责任。

payload.name: CoinGecko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: View top cryptocurrency prices live, crypto charts, market cap, and trading volume. Discover today’s trending coins, top crypto gainers and losers in the market such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Hyperliquid, and more. You can also compare them side by side in a table.
payload.longDescription: 查看主要加密货币的实时价格、加密货币图表、市值及交易量。发现今日热门币种，以及 Bitcoin、Ethereum、Solana、BNB、Hyperliquid 等市场中涨幅和跌幅领先的加密货币。还可以在表格中并排比较。

payload.name: Webull
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore global market data and portfolio insights through AI-powered conversations. Webull MCP provides convenient, read-only access to market information, account balances, positions, and investment insights, helping users interact with financial information in a more intuitive and accessible way.
payload.longDescription:
通过人工智能驱动的对话探索全球市场数据和投资组合洞察。
Webull MCP 提供市场信息、账户余额、持仓和投资见解的便捷只读访问，帮助用户以更直观和易用的方式与金融信息互动。

payload.name: Parqet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ChatGPT to understand your Parqet portfolios: current holdings, value, performance, dividends, and transaction history based on your own data.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT，依据自己的数据了解 Parqet 投资组合：当前持仓、价值、表现、股息及交易历史。

payload.name: Financial Datasets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Financial Datasets gives ChatGPT access to structured stock market data for 27,000+ active and delisted U.S. tickers. Research companies and markets with real-time and historical prices, primary-source SEC filings, financial statements and metrics, earnings, operating KPIs, news, insider and institutional ownership, index fund holdings, interest rates, and stock screening.
payload.longDescription: Financial Datasets 让 ChatGPT 访问 27,000+ 个在交易及已退市美国股票代码的结构化市场数据。利用实时和历史价格、一手 SEC 申报文件、财务报表和指标、财报、经营关键绩效指标（KPI）、新闻、内部人士及机构持股、指数基金持仓、利率和股票筛选开展企业与市场研究。

payload.name: Ramp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Ramp account to ChatGPT and manage finances through natural conversation.

For Finance Teams: Analyze spend trends, identify top expenses, spot anomalies, and run queries on transactions, vendors, and budgets—all in real time without leaving ChatGPT.

For Employees: Check card balances, activate cards, add transaction memos, request reimbursements, get policy answers, and manage travel expenses instantly.

Access is permission-based: employees see only their data, while admins get full analytics and team oversight.
payload.longDescription:
将 Ramp 账户连接至 ChatGPT，通过自然对话管理财务。

财务团队：实时分析支出趋势、识别主要支出、发现异常，并查询交易、供应商及预算，无需离开 ChatGPT。

员工：即时查看卡片余额、激活卡片、添加交易备注、申请报销、获取政策解答，并管理差旅费用。

访问基于权限：员工仅能查看自己的数据，管理员可获得完整分析和团队监督功能。

payload.name: Intuit Credit Karma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Credit Karma brings together credit insights, spending analysis, and personalized offers in one place. Understand the factors affecting your credit score, track your spending by category over time, and connect your accounts for budgeting insights. Compare personalized credit card and personal loan options with clear, conversational guidance to make confident financial decisions.
payload.longDescription: Credit Karma 将信用洞察、支出分析及个性化方案集中在一处。了解影响信用评分的因素、按类别跟踪不同时期的支出，并连接账户获取预算洞察。借助清晰的对话式指导，比较个性化信用卡及个人贷款选项，自信作出财务决策。

payload.name: Stocktwits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stocktwits connects AI assistants to one of the world’s largest communities of traders and investors.

Search stocks, ETFs, crypto, futures, and other markets using natural language to access real-time market conversations, retail sentiment, trending symbols, Watcher activity, and community insights. 

Whether you’re researching an earnings reaction, monitoring sentiment around a ticker, tracking breaking news, or discovering emerging market themes and trade ideas, Stocktwits provides context behind market moves, not just price updates.
payload.longDescription:
Stocktwits 将 AI 助手连接到全球规模最大的交易者和投资者社区之一。

用自然语言搜索股票、ETF、加密货币、期货及其他市场，获取实时市场讨论、散户情绪、热门代码、关注者活动和社区洞察。

无论是研究市场对财报的反应、监测某个股票代码的情绪、追踪突发新闻，还是发现新兴市场主题和交易思路，Stocktwits 都提供市场变动背后的背景，而不仅仅是价格更新。

payload.name: CoinMarketCap
payload.description: 实时加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.

Beyond prices: technical analysis (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Fibonacci levels, pivot points), on-chain metrics like holder distribution and supply breakdowns, and global market signals including BTC dominance, Fear & Greed Index, altcoin season gauge, leverage stats, and ETF flows.

Discover trending crypto narratives, upcoming macro events that move markets, breaking crypto news, and semantic search across crypto concepts, whitepapers, and project documentation.
payload.longDescription:
获取 CoinMarketCap 跟踪的数百万种加密资产的实时价格、市值和交易量，涵盖主要加密货币，以及各大区块链上的长尾 DEX 代币。

不止于价格：提供技术分析（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、斐波那契价位、枢轴点）、持币者分布及供应量细分等链上指标，以及全球市场信号，包括 BTC 市值占比、恐惧与贪婪指数、山寨币季指标、杠杆统计和 ETF 资金流。

发现热门加密资产叙事、即将发生且会影响市场的宏观事件、突发加密资产新闻，并对加密资产概念、白皮书和项目文档进行语义搜索。

payload.name: Next Stock - Market Insights
payload.description: 自主开展数据驱动的股票分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Next Stock – Market Insights helps users explore stock market data through structured analysis and historical performance metrics.

The app delivers short-term and long-term stock picks, categorized stock rankings, portfolio breakdowns, and educational market insights based on publicly available financial data.

Users can explore different investment styles such as growth, value, dividend, and conservative strategies, while accessing curated market summaries, earnings highlights, and financial transcripts.

Designed to support independent research and financial literacy, Next Stock – Market Insights provides clear, data-driven tools to help users better understand market trends and investment strategies. The app does not provide personalized financial advice.
payload.longDescription:
Next Stock – Market Insights 通过结构化分析和历史表现指标，帮助用户探索股票市场数据。

应用依据公开财务数据，提供短期和长期股票精选、分类股票排名、投资组合拆解，以及具有教育意义的市场洞察。

用户可探索成长、价值、股息和保守策略等不同投资风格，同时获取精选市场摘要、财报要点和财务会议文字记录。

Next Stock – Market Insights 旨在支持独立研究和金融知识学习，提供清晰、数据驱动的工具，帮助用户更好地理解市场趋势和投资策略。此应用不提供个性化财务建议。

payload.name: Bybit
payload.description: 实时加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.

StrategyTune是交易策略回测平台，该插件为ChatGPT提供了直接访问它的途径。

ChatGPT可以编写并保存您构建的组件——图表指标、可重用的市场条件（StrategyTune将它们称为信号和过滤器），以及完整的交易策略——然后在StrategyTune的沙盒云环境中对真实历史市场数据进行逐tick回测。简单的策略可在数秒内完成一年历史数据的回测，让您能够快速迭代。

它不仅限于自动化策略回测。ChatGPT可以在同一沙盒中运行自定义研究代码：统计特定条件出现的频率、测量特定时刻的数值、在运行过程中收集自定义统计信息并生成日志。您可以指定要检查的内容，ChatGPT会编写代码、运行它、读取输出并告知您发现的结果。

回测完成后您将获得完整报告——包括绩效统计和支撑这些数据的具体交易。ChatGPT还可以操作您已打开的StrategyTune图表：读取K线和每个指标的计算值，添加并配置指标，将这些条件标记在时间轴上以查看它们具体何时有效，还可切换交易品种或时间周期。读取计算值还能帮助它调试自身工作：如果它编写的指标在您的图表上显示异常，它可以检查线条背后的实际数值而非猜测。

所有操作均基于历史数据进行。该插件不连接经纪商、不执行实时订单或提供投资建议。
